title: Semantic Alignment of EEG and Text: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Decoding Imagined Speech
abstract: arXiv:2610.20766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Imagined speech decoding from EEG offers a promising route toward naturalistic brain-computer interfaces. Traditional closed-set classifiers treat semantic categories as independent labels and do not explicitly exploit relationships among linguistic intents, limiting output flexibility. We adapt a multimodal contrastive learning framework to imagined speech, aligning EEG trials with language representations in the embedding space of a frozen pretrained text encoder. An EEG encoder is trained with a composite objective combining semantically reweighted EEG-sentence alignment and text-prototype-based class discrimination, encouraging semantic structure while preserving separability among 39 intent categories. We evaluate the approach on the Chisco imagined speech dataset across five subjects, reporting Top-k accuracy, macro-F1, and balanced pairwise matching accuracy (2v2). We also investigate maximum EEG-text cosine similarity (MaxCosine)

translated_title: 脑电与文本的语义对齐：一种用于想象语音解码的对比学习框架
translated_abstract: 从脑电（EEG）信号中解码想象语音为实现自然的人机交互提供了一条有前景的途径。传统封闭集分类器将语义类别视为独立的标签，未能显式利用语言意图之间的关系，从而限制了输出的灵活性。我们将多模态对比学习框架应用于想象语音任务，在冻结的预训练文本编码器的嵌入空间中，将脑电试验数据与语言表示进行对齐。脑电编码器通过复合目标函数进行训练，该目标结合了语义重加权的脑电-句子对齐损失和基于文本原型的类别判别损失，在保持39个意图类别可分性的同时，鼓励模型学习语义结构。我们在Chisco想象语音数据集上对五名受试者进行了评估，报告了Top-k准确率、宏平均F1以及平衡成对匹配准确率（2v2）。我们还研究了脑电-文本最大余弦相似度（MaxCosine）
tldr: 本文提出一种多模态对比学习框架，通过在冻结文本编码器的嵌入空间中对齐脑电信号与语言表示，结合语义重加权的脑电-句子对齐和基于文本原型的类别判别，实现对39类想象语音意图的语义化解码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal contrastive learning framework that aligns EEG signals with language representations in the embedding space of a frozen text encoder, combining semantically reweighted EEG-sentence alignment and text-prototype-based class discrimination to achieve semantic decoding of imagined speech across 39 intent categories.
